title: Choose the visual world for Visus
question: The roll assigned Lens Carton. Keep it, take my pick or the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Lens Carton
options.lineage: contact lens and optical retail packaging
options.thesis: Every shift is printed like a lens carton: one colour band, one big number, one ruled spec block.
options.viewport: The landing is one carton face: violet band with the Visus mark, a huge 15:00 as the box's power figure, and three tear tabs that log you straight into the demo as professional, clinic or admin.
options.risk: Tips into gimmick if every element gets a perforation, and drifts clinical if the inks are printed timidly.

raised.raise: Strict ink budget: two spot inks plus black, overprinted where bands meet; no other colour anywhere.
Quantities own fixed digit positions: rates, counts and the 15:00 countdown change digit by digit, never by reflow.
Every carton ends in a tight ruled spec block, the shift's billing lines locked to its foot.
The band states the stage: open, negotiating and filled read from the band before any text.
One hub per screen: the big number is where the eye lands, everything else is subordinate.
Controls are their own printed layer (the tear tab) sitting above the panel, never inked into it.

options.label: Rx Pad
options.lineage: optometrist prescription pads and lab order envelopes
options.thesis: Every shift is written up like a prescription: ruled form fields, ballpoint blue entries, a rubber-stamp verification.
options.viewport: A single tall Rx sheet: the Visus letterhead, today's open shifts filled into the ruled order lines, and a red VERIFIED stamp over the credential field.
options.risk: The most familiar direction for anything medical; paper-form skeuomorphism can read like a patient portal.

options.label: Risograph Web System
options.thesis: Shifts as two-ink riso prints, misregistered on toothy paper.
options.viewport: Fluoro pink and blue blocks overprinting a clinic map.
options.case: Fuses loosely: recruiters and clinic staff do not see themselves in zine culture, and misregistration fights the legibility of rates and times.
options.kept: Its strict spot-ink budget, overprinting where colours meet.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.thesis: The 15-minute window as glowing tube digits.
options.viewport: A tube bank counting down over a steel panel.
options.case: Fuses on the countdown only, and its dark techy ground is exactly what you ruled out.
options.kept: Quantities own fixed digit positions and change digit by digit.

options.label: Saturday Title Card
options.thesis: Each shift slams in as a starburst title card.
options.viewport: A starburst with Visus bowed across it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: too playful, which you ruled out, and it undercuts trust in credentials.
options.kept: One hub per screen where the eye lands.

options.label: Noir One-Sheet
options.thesis: The negotiation as a two-ink film poster.
options.viewport: A small figure, a huge shadow, a ruled billing block.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dramatic and moody where a staffing product needs plain clarity.
options.risk: Theatrical, near the dark look you ruled out.
options.kept: The tight ruled billing block locked to the foot.

options.label: Multiplane Cel Dawn
options.thesis: Scroll as a camera sinking through painted planes.
options.viewport: Painted forest layers parting toward a lit window.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nothing in optometry staffing lives in a painted forest.
options.risk: Storybook mood with no product in it.
options.kept: Controls live on their own layer above the surface.

options.label: Pickling Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Shifts as jars maturing on a shelf.
options.viewport: Jars ranked on shelf lines with day counts.
options.case: Fuses loosely: the stage-on-the-label idea maps to shift status, but jars mean nothing to the audience.
options.kept: The label band states the stage before any text.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean staffing marketplace, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and shift search on the left, a product screenshot on the right, logos and feature cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every staffing startup by design.
